verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm and platform that publishes visa guides, so explaining premium processing is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions premium processing, Form I-907, which classifications qualify, its fee, or what it does and does not speed up. General visa-guide and 'moves your case forward fast' claims are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider explains premium processing (Form I-907) mechanics — which classifications qualify, what it costs, and what it does and does not speed up
